fusions.name: Grubbing Chop
fusions.desc: Brings the sharpened blade down edge-first from overhead for 30 damage, then levers the cut open, leaving the target 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds. The hit is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Brush Clearing
fusions.desc: Swings the blade edge-on in a full circle, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles and leaving them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Filed Bevel
fusions.desc: Files the spade's edge sharp, increasing your slashing damage by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Mattock Head
fusions.desc: Conjures a mattock, a chopping edge on one side and a digging blade on the other. It increases your weapon damage by 10% and your attack speed by 5%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.
